notes: Multi-Browser Support: Aure Homepage is now officially available for Mozilla Firefox alongside Google Chrome with complete feature parity.
Real-Time Cross-Tab Sync: All settings, layouts, wallpapers, bookmarks, and widgets sync instantly across all open tabs without refreshing.
Live IP & Country Flag: View public IP address and country flag directly in Network Status with a dedicated Privacy toggle.
Progress Goals: A new detail modal with full info and all actions, plus customizable sorting options.
Mood Tracker: You can now choose your mood for missed days directly in the tracker grid.
Pomodoro Safeguards: Protective confirmation prompts for timer resets, early breaks, and overtime to prevent lost session progress.
Smarter Countdowns: Clear negative day indicators for expired countdowns and refined reset rules for recurring targets.
Smart Multi-Line Paste: Pasting multi-line text into quick notes automatically enables multi-line editing while preserving formatting.
Pet House Shortcuts: Click-to-copy confirmation phrases when releasing or deleting pets.
Visuals & Polish: New default wallpapers replaced the old ones, renamed Sites & Folders to Bookmarks, and optimized clock performance.
